item.title: Self host sheets, docs, drive, email
item.summary: Selfhost a full suite of collaboration tools powered by onion v3 routing and a isolated three dedicated service architecture. Surprisingly usable latency for realtime collaboration on sheets/docs. Host on Linux, macos, termux. https://gitlab.com/here_forawhile/tmailplus Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49428836 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
